labels.FL-036: The curators have the right tools and standard procedures for their work, and act as surgeons: minimally invasive, targeting the root problem and letting the system sort out the symptoms.
labels.FL-038: A cheap 80/20 duplicate check at memory creation, keeping the agent's memory work under 10% of build run time.
labels.FL-042: Constitution: 'Already known — reinforced' on re-saves; rejected candidates remembered and never re-proposed without material change (gate-day).
labels.FL-051: A performance score for the memory system, back-tested on the history of manual adds and removes plus successful injections; a new set of weights is accepted only if it scores better than the previous generation.
labels.FL-052: The scoreboard counts right and wrong injection decisions, injected or not, with no arbitrary scoring.
labels.FL-055: Background retraining on work-based triggers, with one "force retrain" button as the only manual lever.
labels.FL-056: Automatic training of the memory line and the share from human feedback, switching on by itself after 100 pieces of authentic feedback.
labels.FL-058: A standing registry of every trainable parameter; all training loops triggered from one place in the code where their documentation lives.
labels.FL-060: An optimization ledger: state and scores across runs in a proper history schema.
labels.FL-109: Memory candidates appear under the agent's post on the Deck after a compaction or a thread close; scrolling past without denying approves them; corpus-born proposals live in Memory Ingest.
labels.FL-114: Memory Ingest as its own module: put in current AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files to jump-start the Palace.
labels.FL-178: Constitution: a verification identity with its own account and home for tests and scouts (gate verification-identity work).
labels.FL-179: Constitution: a plain ownership refusal when one identity tries to decide another identity's approval queue item (gate verification-identity work).
labels.FL-195: The feature ledger generates coverage reports and requires evidence for the rows affected by a build.
labels.FL-196: The rules machine checks citations, frozen law, product vocabulary, seed states and packet precedents.
labels.FL-049: Scoring parameters that can be added and removed easily; curators can add and retire axes over time.
labels.FL-050: Weight refits run offline while the previous weights keep serving; the method (gradient descent, linear programming or a solver) was his guess, and it must not slow things down massively.
labels.FL-059: Optimization at every compaction of a main thread, one at a time under a lock, with mixed and capped back-test material.
labels.FL-061: Compaction instructions tuned by back-test; memory size as a tunable beside the threshold and allotments.
labels.FL-063: The scorer need not stay linear forever, and black-box changes from optimization are fine as long as the features being weighted stay understandable.
labels.FL-163: Seed ingestion at startup: upload markdown files (or the machine's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md) and the curators break them into individual memories.
